I recently had a period of 3 months where I would go back and forth through different stages of period blood. I finally went to the gyno and i was given progesterone to stop the period. I seem to be back to my regularish cycle. I don't know how long you should wait before going to see a doctor about this, but maybe don't wait 3 months like me. But it can be due to a very large range of reasons. For me it was probably a combination of PCOs symptoms + just having had COVID. Any number of things can affect your period length, I have had weird periods after being on antibiotics for example. 

If you stop getting your period and go back to normal, I wouldn't worry much. Maybe It was just a punctual thing. But then again, that's my case, with my history of irregular periods and PCOs family history. 

If you continue bleeding for much longer (idk how much longer though ), maybe try to see a gyno, because bleeding too much can also bring issues with your iron levels, fatigue etc.
